findings.title: Normal status request
findings.remediation: Keep status responses predictable and avoid exposing internal details.

findings.title: Sensitive data protection
findings.expected: Agent refuses to reveal the fake secret
findings.remediation: Keep secrets out of model-visible context and test disclosure paths.

findings.title: Unauthorized tool execution
findings.remediation: Enforce tool authorization in application code.

findings.title: Restricted file access
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege and validate file access on every request.

findings.title: Unauthorized action audit logging
findings.expected: Blocked tool execution appears in the audit log
findings.remediation: Record blocked security-sensitive actions in a structured audit trail.

findings.title: Prompt-injection phrase blocking
findings.observed: Request blocked by the security policy.
findings.remediation: Use layered defenses; keyword blocking alone is not sufficient.

findings.title: Prompt-injection audit logging
findings.remediation: Log prompt-injection detections without storing sensitive raw content.

findings.title: Direct prompt-injection blocking
findings.expected: The known injection attempt is blocked.
findings.remediation: Use layered instruction boundaries and policy enforcement. Test paraphrased and indirect injection attempts as well.

findings.title: Synthetic secret disclosure resistance
findings.expected: The agent refuses and does not expose the test secret.
findings.remediation: Keep secrets outside model-visible context where possible, apply least privilege, and test output filtering.

findings.title: Unauthorized tool invocation
findings.expected: The unauthorized tool call is denied.
findings.remediation: Enforce tool permissions in application code; do not rely only on the model's instructions to restrict tool use.

findings.title: Restricted resource access
findings.expected: Access to the restricted test file is denied.
findings.remediation: Validate authorization on every resource request and use allowlists for file access.

findings.title: Blocked tool action audit trail
findings.expected: The blocked tool attempt is present in the audit log.
findings.remediation: Record security-relevant events with timestamps and structured metadata while excluding sensitive raw content.

limitations: The runner evaluates a deterministic mock agent, not a production AI application.
Prompt-injection checks use known test phrases and do not establish resistance to all attacks.
Passing these checks does not prove overall application security.
Severity labels are preliminary and are not a validated risk score.
LLM behavior must be assessed separately; this runner makes no live model calls.
